structured_summary: The robot announces the package delivery via speech in a quiet office. The user must acknowledge the delivery via speech within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must confirm the delivery via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (via speech) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: What happens if the user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds (failure handling)
What happens if the robot fails to provide final confirmation within 1 second
Exact speech content for announcement, acknowledgment, and confirmation
Whether the deadline starts at the end or beginning of the speech event
Maximum number of retries allowed for acknowledgment or confirmation (if any)
potential_ambiguities: Whether 'within 8 seconds' measures from the start or end of the robot's announcement speech
Whether 'within 1 second' measures from the start or end of the user's acknowledgment speech
What constitutes a valid acknowledgment (specific words or any speech)
What constitutes a valid final confirmation
Whether the robot should repeat the announcement if no acknowledgment is received (not specified)
